text.p: CompuServe said that it now had 75,000 subscribers in France, which was a rise of 130 percent in one year, and 850,000 in Europe.
Bertrand Usunier, managing director of CompuServe France, declined to make a forecast for the 1997 subscriber level but said the company had the firm intention to remain market leader.
Usunier said the CompuServe's newest software version and general internet standards would allow content providers a secure way of payment via the CompuServe monthly billing system.
He declined to specify CompuServe France's financial results, saying they were part of CompuServe Corp.
